source: scripts/build-openscad-wasm.sh, round-to-nearest variant, from https://github.com/openscad/openscad at commit 98d891340e6007524e69f399162016f9b22584ff (GitHub Actions run 36799890264)

previousBuild.reason: WebAssembly can only round to nearest, and the official build lets CGAL assume it can switch rounding modes. minkowski() hulls failed a CGAL assertion and fell back to a method that took about a minute on some models, and minkowski() meshes differed slightly from desktop OpenSCAD's. This build adds CGAL_ALWAYS_ROUND_TO_NEAREST and changes nothing else.

knownIssues: projection() triggers CGAL assertion failure (openscad-wasm#6, CGAL#7560)
roof() triggers CGAL FPU error (openscad-wasm#5, openscad#5220)
lazy-union may produce incorrect geometry (disabled by default)
nextUpdate: When OpenSCAD's own build sets CGAL_ALWAYS_ROUND_TO_NEAREST for Emscripten, compare its snapshot with this build and move back to the official one
